envelope.description: Read and validate the optional repo setting; wire the phases

body.title: Read and validate the optional repo setting; wire the phases
body.summary: Read an optional per-repo setting for the typecheck command, test command and result format; validate it in basePlan (empty command or a format other than tap or exit-code is refused with InvalidCommandSetting); the setting wins over the Node default with commandsSource 'repo-setting'. Wire the validate and implement phases to pass the profile to the plan and the prompt.
acceptanceChecks: A repo setting wins over the default for a Node and a non-Node project
An empty command or unknown result format is refused naming the field and nothing runs
A non-Node project with a setting gets an independent run judged as stated
validate-task-round test shows a no-command build does not read as passed and a Node round is unchanged
